Alias.name: mapper reset
Alias.script: if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.reset then icesus.mapper.reset() else cecho("\n<red>mapper reset: Icesus package not loaded.<reset>\n") end

Alias.name: mapper save
Alias.script: if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.saveCommand then icesus.mapper.saveCommand() else cecho("\n<red>mapper save: Icesus package not loaded.<reset>\n") end

Alias.script: if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.restoreCommand then icesus.mapper.restoreCommand(matches[2]) else cecho("\n<red>mapper restore: Icesus package not loaded.<reset>\n") end

Alias.script: if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.autosaveCommand then icesus.mapper.autosaveCommand(matches[2]) else cecho("\n<red>mapper autosave: Icesus package not loaded.<reset>\n") end

Alias.name: mapper on/off
Alias.script: if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.setEnabled then icesus.mapper.setEnabled(matches[2] == "on") else cecho("\n<red>mapper on/off: Icesus package not loaded.<reset>\n") end

Alias.name: mapper outworld
Alias.script: if icesus and icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.outworldCommand then icesus.mapper.outworldCommand(matches[2]) else cecho("\n<red>mapper outworld: Icesus package not loaded.<reset>\n") end

Alias.name: hud
Alias.script: if icesus and icesus.hudCommand then icesus.hudCommand(matches[2]) else cecho("\n<red>hud: Icesus package not loaded.<reset>\n") end

Script.name: icesus.core
Script.script:
-- Icesus Mudlet package — core -- https://github.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package -- -- One Lua script defines the whole package. Everything lives under the -- global `icesus` table. On (re)load the previous instance is torn down -- and a fresh one installed, so editing this script and saving in -- Mudlet's IDE replaces the running HUD cleanly. -- -- Visual language ported from the play.icesus.org web client -- (Icesus-mud/webclient, css/style.css). Colour tokens live in -- icesus.palette below; gauge gradients use Qt's qlineargradient.
icesus = icesus or {} -- Single-source version from the .mpackage's config.lua via Mudlet's -- package info; fall back to the literal for dev hot-reload from disk -- (when this file isn't loaded as an installed package yet). icesus.version = (getPackageInfo and getPackageInfo("Icesus") and getPackageInfo("Icesus").version) or "1.0.19"
-- Hot-reload teardown. if type(icesus.teardown) == "function" then pcall(icesus.teardown) end
-- ============================================================= -- Config — layout and feed defaults. -- -- Don't edit these to customise: the auto-update reinstalls the whole -- package and takes local edits with it. Put overrides in -- getMudletHomeDir()/Icesus.user.lua instead — see the player -- customisation section below, or run `hud example` in-game. -- ============================================================= icesus.config = { -- Which side the combat / comms column sits on: "right" or "left". hudSide = "right", -- Check GitHub for a newer release once per session and reinstall. -- Turning this off means you update by hand; the package will not -- tell you when it is out of date. autoUpdate = true, borderTop = 92, -- banner: identity + EXP (px) borderRight = 360, -- right column width (px) -- Bottom strip, top → bottom: vitals gauges (32) → exits row (28) → -- (Mudlet's command line sits below borderBottom). Slimmer than v0.3.3 -- so the bars stay legible without dominating the screen. borderBottom = 64, -- vitals (32) + exits (28) + 4 px gap (px) channelLines = 500, channelTimes = true, -- EXP bar grows with the window but never sprawls past expMaxW so -- the value text stays close to the eye on widescreens. expMaxW = 720, }
-- ============================================================= -- Settings — player preferences persisted across sessions in -- getMudletHomeDir()/Icesus.settings.lua. Deliberately a separate -- file from the mapper idmap so `mapper reset` never wipes them. -- ============================================================= local function settingsPath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Icesus.settings.lua" end
function icesus.loadSettings() local t = {} if io.exists and io.exists(settingsPath()) then pcall(table.load, settingsPath(), t) end icesus.settings = { -- "auto": deferred idle flush (historic behaviour). "manual": the -- player saves via `mapper save` / the HUD badge; the map is still -- flushed on exit, disconnect and package teardown either way. mapSaveMode = (t.mapSaveMode == "manual") and "manual" or "auto", -- `mapper off` pauses all Room.Info processing (no room creation, -- no exit rewiring, no recentering) without touching the saved -- map. `mapper on` resumes. mapperEnabled = (t.mapperEnabled ~= false), -- `mapper outworld full|roads|off` — how much of the outworld -- grid gets mapped. The outworld is 95+% of a mature map's rooms -- and all of it lands in one giant gridmode area, which is what -- makes engine-side room teardown so slow; "roads" keeps just -- the road/path network, "off" adds no outworld tiles at all. outworldMode = (t.outworldMode == "roads" or t.outworldMode == "off") and t.outworldMode or "full", -- HUD preferences set by the `hud` command. nil means "leave the -- script default alone"; Icesus.user.lua overrides these in turn -- (see icesus.user.apply). hudSide = (t.hudSide == "left" or t.hudSide == "right") and t.hudSide or nil, hudFont = (type(t.hudFont) == "string" and t.hudFont ~= "") and t.hudFont or nil, chatSize = (tonumber(t.chatSize) and tonumber(t.chatSize) > 0) and tonumber(t.chatSize) or nil, -- One-shot: the "you can customise this" line has been shown. hudHintShown = t.hudHintShown and true or nil, } end
function icesus.saveSettings() if icesus.settings then pcall(table.save, settingsPath(), icesus.settings) end end
-- ============================================================= -- Palette — ported from webclient/css/style.css :root tokens. -- ============================================================= icesus.palette = { bgDeep = "#0c0e1a", bgMain = "#131629", bgPanel = "#1a1e35", bgInput = "#0f1225", border = "#2a2f4e", borderBright = "#3a3f5e", text = "#c8cdd8", textDim = "#8b90a5", textBright = "#eef0f6", ice = "#7dd3fc", iceBright = "#bae6fd", iceGlow = "rgba(125,211,252,0.25)", green = "#3ddc84", red = "#f87171", amber = "#fbbf24", cyan = "#38bdf8", -- Gauge gradients (start, end). Match webclient .gauge-fill.* rules. -- Cold-pass: cooler stops across the board so the HUD reads as a -- frosted dashboard, not a candy-coloured one. HP / SP stay vivid -- because alarm and mana are meant to grab the eye; EXP / PSP / cast -- got pulled toward forest / muted violet / glacier cyan respectively. hpGrad = { "#8b1a1a", "#dc2626" }, hpGradC = { "#7f1d1d", "#b91c1c" }, -- critical spGrad = { "#1e3a8a", "#3b82f6" }, epGrad = { "#7c5314", "#b45309" }, -- darker amber, less highlighter pspGrad = { "#5b1a8b", "#9333ea" }, -- one notch off neon expGrad = { "#14532d", "#16a34a" }, -- forest, not lime castGrad = { "#0e7490", "#22d3ee" }, -- glacier cyan, not arcane purple }
icesus.fontStack = '"JetBrains Mono", "DejaVu Sans Mono", "Courier New", monospace'
-- ============================================================= -- Font sizes — the effective size of each piece of HUD text. -- Qt silently ignores the CSS font-size on some Mudlet builds, so -- every widget also gets a setFontSize() call; these are the numbers -- it passes. Override per key from Icesus.user.lua. -- ============================================================= icesus.fontSizes = { identity = 15, -- banner: name + class/race/guild carry = 12, -- banner: money / DF / weight exp = 10, -- banner: EXP gauge text location = 13, -- bottom strip: room + exits mapSave = 10, -- bottom strip: map badge + mode pill vitals = 10, -- bottom strip: HP / SP / EP / PSP gauge text momentum = 12, -- column: momentum buttons cast = 12, -- column: cast bar text badges = 11, -- column: effect + cooldown rows enemy = 12, -- column: enemy panel channels = 13, -- column: channel feed }
-- Effective font size for a HUD widget; `dflt` keeps the HUD legible -- if an override zeroed or removed the key. local function fsz(key, dflt) local n = tonumber(icesus.fontSizes and icesus.fontSizes[key]) if n and n > 0 then return n end return dflt end
-- ============================================================= -- Channel feed styling — cecho colour names for the channel panel. -- `perChannel` keys off the server's own channel or speech name -- ("chat", "sales", "newbie", "say", "shout") and wins over the -- generic `channel` / `speech` colours. Override from -- Icesus.user.lua. -- ============================================================= icesus.chatStyle = { time = "grey", -- HH:MM stamp channel = "DodgerBlue", -- [chat], [sales], ... tell = "MediumOrchid", -- [tell] speech = "DodgerBlue", -- [say], [shout], [whisper] emote = "SteelBlue", -- [emote] in the room talker = "gold", -- who is speaking selfTalker = "DimGrey", -- your own lines text = "", -- "" keeps the server's own colours perChannel = {}, -- e.g. { newbie = "SpringGreen" } }
-- ============================================================= -- Effect badge styling — mirrors webclient .effect-* CSS classes. -- Unknown effects fall back to the neutral "default" entry. -- ============================================================= icesus.effectStyles = { ["bleeding"] = { fg = "#f87171", bg = "rgba(248,113,113,0.18)", bd = "rgba(248,113,113,0.40)" }, ["stunned"] = { fg = "#fbbf24", bg = "rgba(251,191,36,0.18)", bd = "rgba(251,191,36,0.40)" }, ["poisoned"] = { fg = "#4ade80", bg = "rgba(74,222,128,0.18)", bd = "rgba(74,222,128,0.40)" }, ["burning"] = { fg = "#fb923c", bg = "rgba(251,146,60,0.18)", bd = "rgba(251,146,60,0.40)" }, ["death-sickness"] = { fg = "#a78bfa", bg = "rgba(167,139,250,0.18)", bd = "rgba(167,139,250,0.40)" }, ["death sickness"] = { fg = "#a78bfa", bg = "rgba(167,139,250,0.18)", bd = "rgba(167,139,250,0.40)" }, ["frozen"] = { fg = "#7dd3fc", bg = "rgba(125,211,252,0.18)", bd = "rgba(125,211,252,0.40)" }, ["chilled"] = { fg = "#bae6fd", bg = "rgba(186,230,253,0.18)", bd = "rgba(186,230,253,0.40)" }, ["blessed"] = { fg = "#fde047", bg = "rgba(253,224,71,0.18)", bd = "rgba(253,224,71,0.40)" }, ["cursed"] = { fg = "#c084fc", bg = "rgba(192,132,252,0.18)", bd = "rgba(192,132,252,0.40)" }, -- Concealment (Char.Status "stealth") shares this table so it can be -- restyled the same way, but wears cool, quiet colours: this is a -- state the player switched on, not bad news happening to them. ["moving silently"] = { fg = "#94a3b8", bg = "rgba(148,163,184,0.14)", bd = "rgba(148,163,184,0.30)" }, ["hiding in shadows"] = { fg = "#a5b4fc", bg = "rgba(165,180,252,0.14)", bd = "rgba(165,180,252,0.32)" }, ["invisible"] = { fg = "#c4b5fd", bg = "rgba(196,181,253,0.14)", bd = "rgba(196,181,253,0.34)" }, -- Karma the player spent on themselves (Char.Status "karmas"): gold, -- and no alarm palette, for the same reason as concealment. One -- shared style; a single karma can be restyled on its own under -- "karma <name>" -- ["karma exp"] = { fg = ... }. ["karma"] = { fg = "#fcd34d", bg = "rgba(252,211,77,0.12)", bd = "rgba(252,211,77,0.30)" }, default = { fg = "#cbd5e1", bg = "rgba(148,163,184,0.15)", bd = "rgba(148,163,184,0.30)" }, }
local function effectStyle(name) local key = tostring(name or ""):lower() local style = icesus.effectStyles[key] if not style and key:sub(1, 6) == "karma " then style = icesus.effectStyles.karma end return style or icesus.effectStyles.default end
-- Concealment states, shortened for the combat column. Spelled out, -- "MOVING SILENTLY" and "HIDING IN SHADOWS" fill the badge row between -- them and leave no room for an actual effect; the web client's top bar -- wraps and can afford the full words. A state this build has never -- heard of falls through and is shown as the server named it. local STEALTH_LABEL = { ["moving silently"] = "silent", ["hiding in shadows"] = "hidden", ["invisible"] = "invis", }
-- The mark the web client puts on a karma badge, so a MOMENTUM karma -- is not read as the momentum button. local KARMA_MARK = "\226\152\175" -- U+262F
-- ============================================================= -- Guild resource colours -- the readings beside the vitals gauges. -- Ported from the web client's .gr-* classes; the bond colours are -- the ones the in-game bond table uses (air cyan, water blue, fire -- red, earth orange). `other` is what a scalar this build has never -- heard of wears. Override from Icesus.user.lua. -- ============================================================= icesus.guildStyles = { fury = "#fb923c", vitae = "#fb7185", charm = "#5eead4", air = "#67e8f9", water = "#60a5fa", fire = "#f87171", earth = "#fbbf24", other = "#7dd3fc", }
-- ============================================================= -- Player customisation. -- -- The auto-update reinstalls this package wholesale, so any edit made -- inside this script is lost with the next release. Overrides live in -- two optional files in getMudletHomeDir() instead, which install, -- update, uninstall and `mapper reset` never touch: -- -- Icesus.user.lua data. Returns a table of overrides for config / -- palette / fontSizes / chatStyle / effectStyles, -- plus hudSide and fontStack. `hud example` -- writes a commented starter file. -- Icesus.custom.lua script. Runs before the HUD is built, so it can -- do everything the data file can, plus replace -- any icesus.on* handler and define -- icesus.onHudReady() for widget-level work. -- -- Layering, weakest first: -- script defaults → `hud` command settings → Icesus.user.lua -- → Icesus.custom.lua -- -- Prefer keeping your tweaks in a package of your own? Register for -- the "icesus.hudReady" event, raised at the end of every HUD build. -- ============================================================= icesus.user = icesus.user or {}
local DEFAULT_FONT_STACK = icesus.fontStack
local function shallowCopy(t) local c = {} for k, v in pairs(t) do if type(v) == "table" then local inner = {} for kk, vv in pairs(v) do inner[kk] = vv end c[k] = inner else c[k] = v end end return c end
-- The overridable sections, snapshotted at script load. Re-layering -- (after a `hud reload`, say) restores these first, so a key deleted -- from Icesus.user.lua really does go back to the default instead of -- lingering from the previous pass. local SECTIONS = { "config", "palette", "fontSizes", "chatStyle", "effectStyles", "guildStyles" } local DEFAULTS = {} for _, name in ipairs(SECTIONS) do DEFAULTS[name] = shallowCopy(icesus[name]) end
local userWarnings = {}
local function warnUser(fmt, ...) userWarnings[#userWarnings + 1] = string.format(fmt, ...) end
function icesus.user.dataPath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Icesus.user.lua" end
function icesus.user.scriptPath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Icesus.custom.lua" end
-- Load one of the player's files with our own globals visible to it, -- so Icesus.custom.lua can reach `icesus` and the Mudlet API. Mudlet's -- Lua hands a loadfile()d chunk the real global table anyway; doing it -- explicitly keeps the same code working under Lua 5.1 (LuaJIT, what -- Mudlet ships) and under a sandboxed 5.4 interpreter (the tests). local function loadPlayerFile(path) local f = io.open(path, "r") if not f then return nil, "cannot open " .. path end local src = f:read("*a") f:close() -- 5.2+: load(chunk, name, mode, env). 5.1: load() takes a reader -- function, so the call itself raises and loadstring does the work. local ok, chunk, err = pcall(load, src, "@" .. path, "t", _G) if ok and chunk then return chunk end if ok and err then return nil, err end if loadstring then chunk, err = loadstring(src, "@" .. path) if chunk and setfenv then setfenv(chunk, _G) end return chunk, err end return nil, "cannot load " .. path end
local function fileThere(path) if io.exists then return io.exists(path) and true or false end local f = io.open(path, "r") if f then f:close(); return true end return false end
-- Copy scalar overrides onto a default table. Only keys that already -- exist are accepted, and only values matching the default's type — a -- typo should say so rather than quietly do nothing. Nested tables -- (gauge gradients, perChannel maps) are replaced wholesale, keeping -- string and number leaves. local function mergeScalars(label, dst, src) if type(src) ~= "table" then warnUser("%s: expected a table, got %s — ignored", label, type(src)) return end for k, v in pairs(src) do local cur = dst[k] if cur == nil then warnUser("%s.%s: not a setting, ignored", label, tostring(k)) elseif type(v) ~= type(cur) then warnUser("%s.%s: expected %s, got %s — ignored", label, tostring(k), type(cur), type(v)) elseif type(v) == "table" then local copy = {} for kk, vv in pairs(v) do if type(vv) == "string" or type(vv) == "number" then copy[kk] = vv else warnUser("%s.%s.%s: expected a string, ignored", label, tostring(k), tostring(kk)) end end dst[k] = copy else dst[k] = v end end end
-- Effect badges take new keys as well as overrides: the server can -- start sending an effect this build has never heard of. local function mergeEffectStyles(src) if type(src) ~= "table" then warnUser("effectStyles: expected a table, got %s — ignored", type(src)) return end for name, spec in pairs(src) do local key = tostring(name):lower() if type(spec) ~= "table" then warnUser("effectStyles.%s: expected { fg = .., bg = .., bd = .. }", key) else local cur = icesus.effectStyles[key] or icesus.effectStyles.default icesus.effectStyles[key] = { fg = type(spec.fg) == "string" and spec.fg or cur.fg, bg = type(spec.bg) == "string" and spec.bg or cur.bg, bd = type(spec.bd) == "string" and spec.bd or cur.bd, } end end end
local KNOWN_TOP = { hudSide = true, fontStack = true, config = true, palette = true, fontSizes = true, chatStyle = true, effectStyles = true, guildStyles = true, }
-- Layer 1: back to the script defaults. function icesus.user.reset() userWarnings = {} icesus.fontStack = DEFAULT_FONT_STACK for _, name in ipairs(SECTIONS) do -- Refetched rather than captured: a custom script is allowed to -- swap a whole section table out, and the reset has to land on -- whichever table the rest of the package is reading. local dst = icesus[name] if type(dst) ~= "table" then dst = {} icesus[name] = dst end for k in pairs(dst) do dst[k] = nil end for k, v in pairs(shallowCopy(DEFAULTS[name])) do dst[k] = v end end end
-- Layer 2: the handful of preferences the `hud` command persists. function icesus.user.applySettings() local s = icesus.settings or {} if s.hudSide then icesus.config.hudSide = s.hudSide end if s.hudFont then icesus.fontStack = string.format('"%s", %s', s.hudFont, DEFAULT_FONT_STACK) end if s.chatSize then icesus.fontSizes.channels = s.chatSize end end
-- Layer 3: Icesus.user.lua. function icesus.user.loadData() icesus.user.dataLoaded = false local path = icesus.user.dataPath() if not fileThere(path) then return end
local chunk, err = loadPlayerFile(path) if not chunk then warnUser("Icesus.user.lua: %s", tostring(err)); return end local ok, t = pcall(chunk) if not ok then warnUser("Icesus.user.lua: %s", tostring(t)); return end if type(t) ~= "table" then warnUser("Icesus.user.lua: must end with `return { ... }` (got %s)", type(t)) return end icesus.user.dataLoaded = true
if t.hudSide ~= nil then if t.hudSide == "left" or t.hudSide == "right" then icesus.config.hudSide = t.hudSide else warnUser('hudSide: expected "left" or "right", ignored') end end if t.fontStack ~= nil then if type(t.fontStack) == "string" then icesus.fontStack = t.fontStack else warnUser("fontStack: expected a string, ignored") end end if t.config then mergeScalars("config", icesus.config, t.config) end if t.palette then mergeScalars("palette", icesus.palette, t.palette) end if t.fontSizes then mergeScalars("fontSizes", icesus.fontSizes, t.fontSizes) end if t.chatStyle then mergeScalars("chatStyle", icesus.chatStyle, t.chatStyle) end if t.effectStyles then mergeEffectStyles(t.effectStyles) end if t.guildStyles then mergeScalars("guildStyles", icesus.guildStyles, t.guildStyles) end for k in pairs(t) do if not KNOWN_TOP[k] then warnUser("%s: not a top-level setting, ignored", tostring(k)) end end end
-- Layer 4: Icesus.custom.lua. Runs with the full Mudlet API, before -- the HUD is built, so it can also swap out icesus.on* handlers — -- those are looked up by name at event time, not captured at install. function icesus.user.runScript() icesus.user.scriptLoaded = false local path = icesus.user.scriptPath() if not fileThere(path) then return end
local chunk, err = loadPlayerFile(path) if not chunk then warnUser("Icesus.custom.lua: %s", tostring(err)); return end local ok, e = pcall(chunk) if ok then icesus.user.scriptLoaded = true else warnUser("Icesus.custom.lua: %s", tostring(e)) end end
-- The whole stack, in order. Safe to call again at any time. function icesus.user.apply() icesus.user.reset() icesus.user.applySettings() icesus.user.loadData() icesus.user.runScript() end
-- Echoed once after the ready banner rather than during load, so the -- login screen stays quiet and a broken override file is impossible to -- miss. function icesus.user.report() if icesus.user.dataLoaded or icesus.user.scriptLoaded then local which = {} if icesus.user.dataLoaded then which[#which + 1] = "Icesus.user.lua" end if icesus.user.scriptLoaded then which[#which + 1] = "Icesus.custom.lua" end cecho(string.format( "<grey>Icesus<reset> customisation loaded from <cyan>%s<reset>.\n", table.concat(which, "<reset> and <cyan>"))) end for _, w in ipairs(userWarnings) do cecho(string.format("<yellow>Icesus<reset> %s\n", w)) end if #userWarnings > 0 then cecho("<grey>Fix the file and run <yellow>hud reload<reset>" .. "<grey>, or <yellow>hud<reset><grey> for the current state.<reset>\n") end end
function icesus.user.warnings() return userWarnings end
local EXAMPLE_FILE = [==[ -- Icesus.user.lua — personal overrides for the Icesus Mudlet package. -- -- This file is yours. The package's auto-update never touches it, so -- everything set here survives every release. Data only: return a -- table, don't call Mudlet functions (use Icesus.custom.lua for that). -- -- Edit, then run `hud reload` in-game — no relog needed. -- Delete a line to go back to the package default. -- -- Every setting, with what it does and what values it takes: -- https://github.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package#customising -- Colour names you can use: type lua showColors() in Mudlet. -- Fonts you have installed: type lua getAvailableFonts()
return { -- Which side the combat / comms column sits on: "right" or "left". -- hudSide = "left",
-- Font for the whole HUD. First name that exists on your system wins. -- fontStack = '"Fira Code", "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace',
-- Text sizes. Keys: identity, carry, exp, location, mapSave, vitals, -- momentum, cast, badges, enemy, channels. fontSizes = { -- channels = 11, },
-- Layout. borderTop / borderRight / borderBottom are the HUD's -- reserved strips in pixels; channelLines is the chat scrollback; -- channelTimes toggles the HH:MM stamp. config = { -- borderRight = 420, -- channelTimes = false, },
-- Channel feed colours (Mudlet colour names). perChannel keys off -- the channel or speech name and wins over the generic ones. chatStyle = { -- channel = "SpringGreen", -- talker = "khaki", -- text = "wheat", -- perChannel = { newbie = "SpringGreen", sales = "grey" }, },
-- HUD colours. Same token names the web client uses; *Grad keys take -- a { from, to } pair. palette = { -- ice = "#a5f3fc", -- bgPanel = "#161a30", -- hpGrad = { "#7f1d1d", "#ef4444" }, },
-- Effect badge colours. fg = text, bg = fill, bd = border. New effect -- names are allowed here, not just the ones the package ships with, -- and the concealment badges live here too. Leave a key out to keep -- the shipped value. effectStyles = { -- poisoned = { fg = "#4ade80", bg = "rgba(74,222,128,0.18)", -- bd = "rgba(74,222,128,0.40)" }, -- ["hiding in shadows"] = { fg = "#a5b4fc" }, -- Karma badges share one entry; one karma on its own is -- ["karma exp"] = { fg = ... }. -- karma = { fg = "#fcd34d" }, },
-- Guild readings beside the vitals gauges: fury, vitae, the active -- charm, and the four bond elements. `other` is what a resource the -- package has never heard of wears. CSS colours. guildStyles = { -- fury = "#f97316", -- air = "#22d3ee", -- other = "#a5f3fc", }, } ]==]
-- `hud example` — drop a commented starter file next to the settings, -- never over an existing one. function icesus.user.writeExample() local path = icesus.user.dataPath() if fileThere(path) then cecho(string.format( "\n<yellow>Icesus<reset> <cyan>%s<reset> already exists " .. "\226\128\148 not overwriting it.\n", path)) return false end local f = io.open(path, "w") if not f then cecho(string.format( "\n<red>Icesus<reset> couldn't write <cyan>%s<reset>.\n", path)) return false end f:write(EXAMPLE_FILE) f:close() cecho(string.format( "\n<lime_green>Icesus<reset> wrote <cyan>%s<reset>.\n" .. "<grey>Every setting is commented out. Uncomment what you want, " .. "then run <yellow>hud reload<reset><grey>.<reset>\n", path)) return true end
-- Shown once per profile, right after the first ready banner: the only -- moment a player learns the HUD is theirs to change. function icesus.hudHint() icesus.settings = icesus.settings or {} if icesus.settings.hudHintShown then return end icesus.settings.hudHintShown = true icesus.saveSettings() cecho("<grey>Colours, fonts, and which side the panels sit on are " .. "yours to change \226\128\148 type <yellow>hud<reset>" .. "<grey>. Your changes survive updates.<reset>\n") end
-- ============================================================= -- `hud` command — the small set of tweaks worth having without -- writing Lua. elseif verb == "chatsize" then local n = tonumber(rest) if not n or n < 6 or n > 30 then cecho("\n<yellow>Icesus<reset> usage: " .. Webclient ships orange/purple but -- saturated orange feels off-theme on a frozen-planet HUD. paint(icesus.hud.momentumBtn, icesus.state.momentum, "#fca5a5", "rgba(153,27,27,0.20)", "rgba(220,38,38,0.55)") paint(icesus.hud.specialMomentumBtn, icesus.state.specialMomentum, "#d8b4fe", "rgba(91,33,182,0.22)", "rgba(126,34,206,0.55)") -- Where the momentum came from (combat, mining, bellows, polish) -- goes in the tooltip, as on the web client: the button is already -- the widest thing in the column, and the source only matters when -- you stop to wonder why it lit up. local function tip(btn, val, source) if not btn then return end local text = "" if val and val ~= "" then if source and source ~= "" then text = string.format("Momentum from %s \226\128\148 use %s", source, val) else text = "Use " .. val end end pcall(function() btn:setToolTip(text) end) end tip(icesus.hud.momentumBtn, icesus.state.momentum, icesus.state.momentumSource) tip(icesus.hud.specialMomentumBtn, icesus.state.specialMomentum, nil) end

-- Spell casting wins over a generic busy state because Char.Casting -- carries real progress and the bar is more useful filled accurately. if c then setGaugeGrad(icesus.hud.castGauge, P.castGrad) local total = math.max(tonumber(c.cps) or 1, 1) local prog = math.min(math.max(tonumber(c.progress) or 0, 0), total) icesus.hud.castGauge:setValue(prog, total, "casting " .. (c.spell or "")) return end

Fill the bar amber so it reads as -- "you can't do other things right now". if b then setGaugeGrad(icesus.hud.castGauge, { "#7c5314", "#d97706" }) local label = b.activity ~= "" and b.activity or "busy" icesus.hud.castGauge:setValue(1, 1, "busy: " .. label) return end

-- A badge row is one fixed-width Label that does not wrap: whatever -- runs past its right edge is simply not drawn, and the player loses a -- badge without being told. So work out how many character cells the -- row can show and lay the badges out inside that budget — spacing -- first, then the longest names. -- -- The cell width is estimated from the badge font size (Mudlet has no -- portable way to measure a string in a Label), deliberately on the -- generous side: over-estimating costs a little truncation, and -- under-estimating costs a badge. local function badgeCells() -- Row width = the column, less the PAD inset setupHUD gives every -- widget in it on each side. local w = (tonumber(icesus.hudLayout().R) or 360) - 12 local size = fsz("badges", 11) return math.max(math.floor(w / (size * 0.88)), 12) end
local ELLIPSIS = "\226\128\166"
-- Character cells in a UTF-8 string: every byte that is not a -- continuation byte starts one. The karma mark is three bytes and one -- cell, which is why #s will not do here. local function ucells(s) return select(2, tostring(s or ""):gsub("[^\128-\191]", "")) end
-- The first n characters of a UTF-8 string. local function uhead(s, n) local out, i = {}, 0 for ch in tostring(s or ""):gmatch("[%z\1-\127\194-\244][\128-\191]*") do i = i + 1 if i > n then break end out[#out + 1] = ch end return table.concat(out) end
-- pills: { { raw = "BLEEDING", text = .., cells = .. }, ... }, mutated -- in place. Returns the padding and gap that fit, in   cells. local function fitBadges(pills, cells) local n = #pills if n == 0 then return 2, 3 end
local function width(pad, gap) local w = (n - 1) * gap for _, p in ipairs(pills) do w = w + p.cells + pad * 2 end return w end
for _, sp in ipairs({ { 2, 3 }, { 1, 2 }, { 1, 1 } }) do if width(sp[1], sp[2]) <= cells then return sp[1], sp[2] end end
-- Tightest spacing is still too wide: shave the longest name a -- character at a time, so one long affliction cannot push a short -- badge off the end. Names are never cut below 5 cells; past that -- the row is simply too narrow and the tail is lost as before. while width(1, 1) > cells do local worst, len = nil, 0 for _, p in ipairs(pills) do if p.cells > len then worst, len = p, p.cells end end if not worst or len <= 5 then break end worst.cells = len - 1 worst.text = uhead(worst.raw, worst.cells - 1) .. ELLIPSIS end return 1, 1 end
function icesus.refreshEffects() if not icesus.hud or not icesus.hud.effectsRow then return end local fx = icesus.state.effects or {} local sneak = icesus.state.stealth or {} local karma = icesus.state.karmas or {} if #fx == 0 and #sneak == 0 and #karma == 0 then icesus.hud.effectsRow:echo( [[<center><span style="color:#555">no effects</span></center>]]) return end
-- Concealment leads the row and keeps its place instead of shuffling -- as afflictions come and go. It can lapse on its own, and the badge -- vanishing is the warning the player is watching for. local pills = {} local function addPill(label, styleName) local raw = tostring(label):upper() pills[#pills + 1] = { raw = raw, text = raw, cells = ucells(raw), style = effectStyle(styleName) } end for _, s in ipairs(sneak) do local name = tostring(s) addPill(STEALTH_LABEL[name:lower()] or name, name) end -- Karma the player spent on themselves comes next: chosen, not -- inflicted, so it sits with concealment rather than the afflictions. -- It runs for hours, and the badge vanishing is how you learn one -- lapsed. for _, k in ipairs(karma) do local name = tostring(k) addPill(KARMA_MARK .. " " .. name, "karma " .. name:lower()) end for _, e in ipairs(fx) do addPill(e, e) end
local n = #pills local pad, gap = fitBadges(pills, badgeCells()) local padStr = string.rep(" ", pad) local gapStr = string.rep(" ", gap)
-- Qt's HTML-in-QLabel renderer ignores CSS padding/border on inline -- spans on this build, so pills are built from literal   -- whitespace inside a coloured background span. Always works. local parts = { [[<center>]] } for i, p in ipairs(pills) do local label = htmlEscape(p.text):gsub(" ", " ") table.insert(parts, string.format( [[<span style="background:%s;color:%s;font-weight:700">]] .. [[%s%s%s</span>]], p.style.bg, p.style.fg, padStr, label, padStr)) if i < n then table.insert(parts, gapStr) end end table.insert(parts, [[</center>]]) icesus.hud.effectsRow:echo(table.concat(parts)) end
local function cooldownColor(ratio) -- ratio = remaining/total: 1.0 = just fired, 0.0 = ready. Webclient -- uses cyan as default and shifts to green when expiring. if ratio >= 0.75 then return { fg = "#fca5a5", bg = "rgba(248,113,113,0.18)", bd = "rgba(248,113,113,0.40)" } elseif ratio >= 0.20 then return { fg = "#38bdf8", bg = "rgba(56,189,248,0.15)", bd = "rgba(56,189,248,0.30)" } else return { fg = "#4ade80", bg = "rgba(74,222,128,0.20)", bd = "rgba(74,222,128,0.40)" } end end
function icesus.refreshCooldowns() if not icesus.hud or not icesus.hud.cooldownsRow then return end local cds = icesus.state.cooldowns if not cds or #cds == 0 then icesus.hud.cooldownsRow:echo( [[<center><span style="color:#555">ready</span></center>]]) return end
-- Adaptive density: with 3+ cooldowns we truncate long names so -- "breath weapon 90s" doesn't shove the third pill off the right -- edge of the column; with 4+ we also drop the seconds suffix. -- (CSS padding/font-size on inline spans is ignored by Qt's -- HTML-in-QLabel renderer on this build, so density is the only -- knob we have.) local n = #cds local nameMax = (n >= 3) and 8 or 64 local showSecs = (n < 4)
