Uses downloadFile + sysDownloadDone so it's -- non-blocking. Players opt out with `autoUpdate = false` under -- `config` in Icesus.user.lua; the flag is read at first Char.Base. -- =============================================================
icesus.update = icesus.update or {}
local VERSION_URL = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package/master/package/config.lua" local RELEASE_URL = "https://github.com/Icesus-mud/mudlet-package/releases/latest/download/Icesus.mpackage"
local function versionCachePath() return getMudletHomeDir() .. "/Icesus.version.check" end
-- "1.0.10" > "1.0.9" — naive string compare fails; do a numeric one. local function parseVersion(s) if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end local out = {} for n in s:gmatch("(%d+)") do table.insert(out, tonumber(n)) end return out end
local function versionNewer(a, b) local pa, pb = parseVersion(a), parseVersion(b) if not pa or not pb then return false end for i = 1, math.max(#pa, #pb) do local x, y = pa[i] or 0, pb[i] or 0 if x > y then return true end if x < y then return false end end return false end
-- Mudlet's default profile ships `generic_mapper` preinstalled. It -- builds the map from room-title + exits triggers, fighting our -- GMCP-driven mapper for the same Mudlet room IDs and producing a -- confused double graph. If it's present, drop it. function icesus.update.removeGenericMapper() if not getPackages or not uninstallPackage then return end local pkgs = getPackages() if type(pkgs) ~= "table" then return end for _, name in ipairs(pkgs) do if name == "generic_mapper" then pcall(uninstallPackage, "generic_mapper") -- Banner is deferred until first Char.Base so the login / -- character-creation screen stays quiet — see onBase. icesus.update.removedGenericMapper = true return end end end
function icesus.update.check() if not downloadFile or not registerAnonymousEventHandler then return end if icesus.update.checking then return end icesus.update.checking = true
local cache = versionCachePath() local doneHandler, errHandler
local function cleanup() if doneHandler then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, doneHandler) end if errHandler then pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, errHandler) end icesus.update.checking = false end
doneHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadDone", function(_, file) if file ~= cache then return end cleanup() local f = io.open(cache, "r") if not f then return end local body = f:read("*a"); f:close() pcall(os.remove, cache) local latest = body and body:match('version%s*=%s*"([^"]+)"') if not latest then return end if versionNewer(latest, icesus.version) then cecho(string.format( "\n<yellow>Icesus<reset> update available: <lime_green>v%s<reset> " .. "(you have v%s). Installing\226\128\166\n", latest, icesus.version)) -- installPackage() errors if "Icesus" is already installed and -- Mudlet has no atomic reinstall API, so uninstall first then -- reinstall. Anonymous tempTimers and event handlers survive the -- package teardown (they live in Mudlet's runtime pool, not in -- the package XML). Trigger install on sysUninstallPackage, with -- 5s and 10s tempTimer retries as belt-and-braces against -- Mudlet issue #719 (uninstallPackage can hang). local installed = false local function doInstall() if installed then return end installed = true pcall(installPackage, RELEASE_URL) end registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysUninstallPackage", function(_, pkg) if pkg == "Icesus" then doInstall() end end, true) tempTimer(5, doInstall) tempTimer(10, doInstall) pcall(uninstallPackage, "Icesus") end end)
errHandler = registerAnonymousEventHandler("sysDownloadError", function(_, _, file) if file ~= cache then return end cleanup() cecho("\n<yellow>Icesus<reset> couldn't reach GitHub to check " .. "for updates. Will retry next session.\n") end)
pcall(downloadFile, cache, VERSION_URL) end
function icesus.onCooldowns() local d = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.Cooldowns if not d then return end local list = {} if type(d.cooldowns) == "table" then for _, c in ipairs(d.cooldowns) do table.insert(list, { name = c.name or "?", remaining = tonumber(c.remaining) or 0, total = tonumber(c.total) or 0, }) end end icesus.state.cooldowns = list icesus.refreshCooldowns() end
function icesus.onEnemyDeath() local d = gmcp.Char and gmcp.Char.EnemyDeath if not d or not d.name then return end local kept = {} for _, e in ipairs(icesus.state.enemies) do if e.name ~= d.name then table.insert(kept, e) end end icesus.state.enemies = kept icesus.refreshEnemies() end
-- ============================================================= -- Chat / speech routing — uses the four typed packages introduced -- by the server's gmcp Comm.Channel split (mudlib PR #566): -- -- Room.Speech — say / whisper / sing / emote / npc_say -- Room.Ambient — third-person NPC narration ("the bear sniffs") -- Comm.Channel.Tell — private 1:1 tells -- Comm.Channel.Text — broadcast channels (chat, sales, news, ...) -- -- The legacy Comm.Channel is still emitted server-side as a back-compat -- passthrough; we deliberately do NOT subscribe a handler for it, so -- nothing double-renders. Room.Ambient is intentionally dropped — the -- text is already in the main console, and that's what was leaking -- into the player-say pane before the split. -- =============================================================
-- Defensive colour-token strip. Some server-side composers (e.g. the -- hunt event's warden chatter, issue Icesus-mud/issues#667) leak raw -- pinkfish codes like %^BOLD%^ into GMCP chat text. They mean nothing -- to Mudlet and render as literal noise in the feed — drop them. The -- extra parens make gsub return only the string, not the match count. local function stripPinkfish(s) if type(s) ~= "string" then return s end return (s:gsub("%%%^[%w_]+%%%^", "")) end
-- Every colour below comes from icesus.chatStyle, read at echo time so -- an override file (or `hud reload`) takes effect on the next line -- without a HUD rebuild. local function cs() return icesus.chatStyle or {} end
-- Tag chunk for a channel or speech kind. perChannel wins over the -- generic colour, so "chat" and "sales" can differ. local function styleTag(name, generic) local st = cs() local col = (st.perChannel and st.perChannel[name]) or generic or "DodgerBlue" return string.format("<%s>[%s]<reset>", col, tostring(name)) end
-- Optional recolour of the message body. Empty keeps whatever colours -- the server sent. local function styleText(text) local col = cs().text text = tostring(text or "") if col and col ~= "" then return string.format("<%s>%s<reset>", col, text) end return text end
-- Shared echo helper. tag is the colourised header chunk (channel name, -- "tell", or speech kind); body is the rendered "talker: text" string. local function echoChannel(tag, body) if not icesus.hud or not icesus.hud.channels then return end local time = "" if icesus.config.channelTimes then time = string.format("<%s>%s<reset>", cs().time or "grey", os.date("%H:%M ")) end icesus.hud.channels:cecho(string.format( "%s%s %s\n", time, tag, stripPinkfish(body))) end
-- Render "talker: text" with self echoes styled differently so own -- messages stand out without resorting to name comparison. local function fmtTalkerText(talker, text, isSelf) local st = cs() if isSelf then return string.format("<%s>you<reset>: %s", st.selfTalker or "DimGrey", styleText(text)) end return string.format("<%s>%s<reset>: %s", st.talker or "gold", tostring(talker or ""), styleText(text)) end
function icesus.onRoomSpeech() local p = gmcp.Room and gmcp.Room.Speech if not p then return end local kind = tostring(p.kind or "say") local text = tostring(p.text or "") local talker = tostring(p.talker or "") local isSelf = (p.self == 1) or (p.self == true) -- For emotes the server has already woven the talker name into the -- text ("Idles waves cheerfully") — render verbatim, do not prepend. if kind == "emote" then echoChannel(styleTag(kind, cs().emote), styleText(text)) else echoChannel(styleTag(kind, cs().speech), fmtTalkerText(talker, text, isSelf)) end end
function icesus.onCommTell() local p = gmcp.Comm and gmcp.Comm.Channel and gmcp.Comm.Channel.Tell if not p then return end local talker = tostring(p.talker or "") local text = tostring(p.text or "") local isSelf = (p.self == 1) or (p.self == true) echoChannel(styleTag("tell", cs().tell), fmtTalkerText(talker, text, isSelf)) end
function icesus.onCommText() local p = gmcp.Comm and gmcp.Comm.Channel and gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text if not p then return end local channel = tostring(p.channel or "?") local talker = tostring(p.talker or "") local text = tostring(p.text or "") local kind = tostring(p.kind or "say") local isSelf = (p.self == 1) or (p.self == true) -- Channel emotes: text already includes the talker name (parsed by -- EMOTE_D server-side). Render verbatim. if kind == "emote" then echoChannel(styleTag(channel, cs().channel), styleText(text)) else echoChannel(styleTag(channel, cs().channel), fmtTalkerText(talker, text, isSelf)) end end
-- ============================================================= -- Click handlers (must be globals — Geyser passes them as strings). -- ============================================================= function icesus.useMomentum() if icesus.state.momentum and icesus.state.momentum ~= "" then send("use " .. icesus.state.momentum) end end
function icesus.useSpecialMomentum() if icesus.state.specialMomentum and icesus.state.specialMomentum ~= "" then send("use " .. icesus.state.specialMomentum) end end
-- ============================================================= -- GMCP subscription. -- Sending Core.Supports.Set triggers send_all() server-side, so a -- fresh dump of every package arrives immediately. We also send -- Core.Hello so the server can identify us as Mudlet. -- ============================================================= function icesus.subscribeGMCP() sendGMCP('Core.Hello { "client": "Mudlet", "version": "' .. icesus.version .. '" }') -- Char.Base is listed explicitly even though the server's send_all sends -- it regardless of subscription — keeps client intent visible on the -- wire and survives any future server-side gating. -- Comm 1 / Room 1 cover the typed chat packages (Comm.Channel.Tell, -- Comm.Channel.Text, Room.Speech, Room.Ambient). The subpackages are -- listed explicitly so the subscription stays self-documenting and -- survives any future server-side per-package gating. sendGMCP('Core.Supports.Set [' .. '"Char 1", "Char.Base 1", "Char.Vitals 1", "Char.Maxstats 1", ' .. '"Char.Status 1", "Char.Casting 1", "Char.Cooldowns 1", ' .. '"Char.Resources 1", ' .. '"Char.EnemyDeath 1", ' .. '"Comm 1", "Comm.Channel.Tell 1", "Comm.Channel.Text 1", ' .. '"Room 1", "Room.Info 1", "Room.Speech 1"]') end
-- ============================================================= -- Install / uninstall. -- ============================================================= local function reg(event, fn) table.insert(icesus.handlers, registerAnonymousEventHandler(event, fn)) end
-- Register by NAME, not by value: the handler looks the function up on -- the icesus table when the event fires. That is what lets a player -- script replace icesus.onCommText (or any other handler) at any time -- and have it take effect without reinstalling the package. local function regFn(event, name) reg(event, function(...) local fn = icesus[name] if type(fn) == "function" then return fn(...) end end) end
function icesus.install() icesus.uninstall() -- idempotent -- Drop Mudlet's bundled generic_mapper synchronously, before -- anything else. Its mapOpenEvent handler does `send("look")` the -- first time the mapper widget is shown on a profile with no -- saved prompt pattern — and Mudlet auto-restores the widget on -- profile load. With a new character that "look" lands on the -- "Please enter the name you wish for this new player:" prompt, -- which then names the character "look". Doing the uninstall up -- here closes the race; the earlier tempTimer(1) deferral was -- exactly wide enough to lose it. pcall(icesus.update.removeGenericMapper) icesus.loadSettings() -- before setupHUD: the mode pill reads it icesus.user.apply() -- then the player's own overrides on top icesus.setupHUD() regFn("gmcp.Char.Base", "onBase") regFn("gmcp.Char.Vitals", "onVitals") regFn("gmcp.Char.Maxstats", "onMaxstats") regFn("gmcp.Char.Status", "onStatus") regFn("gmcp.Char.Casting", "onCasting") regFn("gmcp.Char.Cooldowns", "onCooldowns") regFn("gmcp.Char.Resources", "onResources") regFn("gmcp.Char.EnemyDeath", "onEnemyDeath") regFn("gmcp.Room.Info", "onRoomInfo") regFn("gmcp.Room.Speech", "onRoomSpeech") regFn("gmcp.Comm.Channel.Tell", "onCommTell") regFn("gmcp.Comm.Channel.Text", "onCommText") regFn("sysConnectionEvent", "subscribeGMCP") regFn("sysExitEvent", "uninstall") -- A network drop / server reboot doesn't close the profile, so -- sysExitEvent never fires there — flush the map on disconnect too. reg("sysDisconnectionEvent", function() if icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.flushSave then pcall(icesus.mapper.flushSave) end end) -- Mapper boot is deferred until the first Char.Base (see onBase): -- that GMCP only fires once a character is logged in, so any -- character-creation flow is finished by then. Booting earlier -- would set up timers and load map state against the login -- screen, with no character context. if isConnected and isConnected() then icesus.subscribeGMCP() end -- "Icesus ready" banner and the self-update check both move to -- onBase so the login / character-creation screen stays quiet. end
function icesus.uninstall() if icesus.handlers then for _, h in ipairs(icesus.handlers) do pcall(killAnonymousEventHandler, h) end icesus.handlers = {} end if icesus.mapper and icesus.mapper.teardown then icesus.mapper.teardown() end icesus.teardownHUD() icesus.booted = nil -- re-arm one-shot Char.Base boot end
icesus.teardown = icesus.uninstall
icesus.install()
